title: First Unique Even Element
summary: Given an integer array, identify the first even number that occurs exactly once.
statement: Given an integer array, identify the first even number that occurs exactly once. If no such number exists, return -1. An even number is divisible by 2.
constraints: Find an even value whose total array frequency is exactly one.
Return the first such value in original order.
hints: Scan nums from left to right.
Return the first value that is even and has count one.
If the scan finishes, the sentinel -1 is required.
editorial: If the scan finishes, the sentinel -1 is required.

tests.explanation: Four repeats; two is the first unique even value.
No even value exists, so return -1.
